MG21.analysis: Goal: chain back on sprockets. Standard: lift chain onto rear cog then chainring. Bottleneck: rust stiffness. Loosen it with penetrating oil and flexing; the rest is standard.
MG21.final:
step1: Spray WD-40 along the chain (WD-40).
step2: Wearing gloves, flex and roll the links by hand until supple; wipe off excess (gloves).
step3: Hook chain over the rear cog, then onto the chainring, turn the pedal to seat it (gloves).
step4: Apply dry lubricant (dry lube).
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG22.analysis: Goal: get the toy down safely. Standard: stand on stable support and sweep or hook it. Hanger hook fails on fuzz and rocking chair is unstable, so use ladder and sweep, not hook.
MG22.final:
step1: Set up the step ladder on level floor near the wardrobe (step ladder); skip the rocking chair.
step2: Climb carefully and sweep the toy toward the edge with the long-bristled brush or wicker broom until it falls (brush/broom).
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG23.analysis: Goal: water free of chemicals. Standard: boil or filter. Boiling does not remove agricultural chemicals, and no filter media, charcoal or chemical treatment exists. Distillation would need a sealed condenser, and volatile pesticides can carry over.
MG23.final:
Not possible: boiling, cloth straining and sanitizer cannot remove dissolved agricultural chemicals, and none of the items provides reliable distillation, activated carbon or chemical treatment. Find another water source.
VERDICT: UNSOLVABLE

MG24.analysis: Goal: isolate DNA. Standard: lyse cells with detergent and salt, then precipitate with cold alcohol. Bottleneck: no reagents at all; filters and bags only handle physical steps.
MG24.final:
Not possible: DNA extraction needs detergent, salt buffer and alcohol, none of which are provided. Bags, filters, beaker and microscope can only crush and filter, not lyse or precipitate DNA.
VERDICT: UNSOLVABLE

MG25.analysis: Goal: snug shoe fit. Standard: add insoles or heel grips. Weak rubber bands and tape are irrelevant; foam and moleskin fill volume and add grip.
MG25.final:
step1: Place foam inserts in the shoes to take up volume (foam inserts).
step2: Stick moleskin pads inside the heel to stop slipping (moleskin pads).
step3: Add felt pads under the forefoot if still loose (felt pads).
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG26.analysis: Goal: secure thick vines high up. Standard: tie with twine. Bottleneck: no twine and short ladder; the shirt frays and scissors are dull. Fray is manageable by tearing and braiding strips.
MG26.final:
step1: Notch the t-shirt with scissors and tear it into long strips by hand (t-shirt, scissors).
step2: Twist or braid 3 strips into thicker cords to resist fraying (gloves).
step3: Tie the vines to the trellis with the cords, using the ladder for the high parts and bending vine tips down within reach (ladder).
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG27.analysis: Goal: contain Legos without boxes. Standard: rigid bins. Bottleneck: thin pantyhose tear. Use bandanas as the sturdy sack, pantyhose only as ties.
MG27.final:
step1: Lay out a bandana and pile Legos in the center; tie the corners into a sack (bandana).
step2: Double-bag with a second bandana for strength (bandana).
step3: Bundle the sacks with pantyhose strips (pantyhose, pocket knife).
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG28.analysis: Goal: measure lengths. Standard: ruler. Need a known unit: a standard sheet of paper has a known size (e.g. A4 29.7 cm or Letter 11 in). Fold it to subdivide and mark.
MG28.final:
step1: Cut a long strip from a sheet of paper, or use its known edge length (A4 29.7 cm / Letter 11 in) as the reference (paper).
step2: Fold the strip in half repeatedly to divide it evenly (paper).
step3: Mark the folds with a pencil and number them (pencil).
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG29.analysis: Goal: dislodge the toy from the chandelier. Standard: reach with a pole. Broom is too short on the floor, but a chair adds height; the toy is light and the string is unnecessary.
MG29.final:
step1: Place the sturdy dining chair under the toy and stand on it carefully (chair).
step2: Use the broom handle to nudge the toy until it falls free, with the cookie sheet or a person underneath as a catch (broom).
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG30.analysis: Goal: stop the leak. Standard: seal with sealant. Bottleneck: sealant is gone, and nothing else here is adhesive or heat-fusible; sandpaper and brushes only prepare surfaces.
MG30.final:
Not possible: sealing needs an adhesive or sealant, which is out. The straw, filter, brushes, sandpaper and gloves cannot plug or bond a leak.
VERDICT: UNSOLVABLE
